source: Installed pinned official dependency sources, read-only; no modified dependencies or newly fetched packages. Exact M1 application source from git object.

contracts.label: sdkBatchProcessor
contracts.contract: forceFlush only drains _finishedSpans; _isExporting does not join an already-sending batch.

contracts.label: otlpExporterBase
contracts.contract: forceFlush delegates to the OTLP export delegate.

contracts.label: otlpDelegate
contracts.contract: Exports push actual transport completion promises; forceFlush calls the promise queue awaitAll.

contracts.label: otlpPromiseQueue
contracts.contract: awaitAll uses Promise.all on the current sending promises, removed only when each settles.

contracts.label: officialWorkflowTelemetry
contracts.contract: Actual official trace helper used by fixture; its successful callback sets parent step status OK then ends it.

contracts.label: officialSpanStatus
contracts.contract: An OK status overrides prior ERROR and later status changes are ignored. Relevant to refused-result proposal.
